description: PAID ($0.002 USDC via x402). Supply, peg health and per-chain breakdown for USDC and other stablecoins: total circulating supply, deviation from the $1.00 peg, peg mechanism, the amount circulating on Base (with its share of total) and the top chains by supply (DefiLlama). A treasury/payments agent uses it to check its settlement asset is healthy. Without payment this returns the 402 challenge; the fiatdock-mcp npm package pays automatically.

asset.description: Stablecoin symbol (default USDC), e.g. USDC, USDT, DAI, USDe

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on Base USDC). OMIT it on the first call: the 402 you get back carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate` — the exact envelope to fill in — plus the price and the EIP-712 domain. Send it on the second call to complete the purchase; it is forwarded as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, never as body data. Nothing is charged for the 402 itself, and a call that fails after payment settles nothing.

name: stablecoin_intel

asOf.description: ISO 8601 time the snapshot was read

note.description: Human-readable caveat about the snapshot, if any

onBase.description: Circulating supply on Base + its share of total

pegDeviationPct.description: Absolute deviation from the peg, % (from $1.00 for a USD stablecoin; for another peg, measured against that currency's USD rate; null when unknown)

pegType.description: What the asset is pegged to (e.g. peggedUSD)

title: Stablecoin intelligence ($0.002)
